findings.title: Active assignment to Global Administrator
findings.description: ssmith@contoso.com (User) holds an active assignment to 'Global Administrator'. This may be a standing assignment or a PIM role activated at scan time; standing assignments are always on, increasing exposure if the principal is compromised.
findings.remediation: Confirm in Privileged Identity Management whether this assignment is permanent. If so, convert it to PIM-eligible so the role is activated on demand with justification and time limits. Reserve permanent assignments for break-glass accounts.

findings.title: Secret 'prod-secret' expiring in 14 days
findings.description: App registration 'Internal Reporting App' has a secret ('prod-secret') expiring on 2026-11-26 (14 days). Threshold: 30 days.
findings.remediation: Rotate the credential before it expires to avoid service disruption. Update the consuming service and remove the old credential.

findings.title: Secret 'initial' expired 210 days ago
findings.description: App registration 'Legacy SharePoint Connector' has an expired secret ('initial') that expired on 2026-04-16. If the app is still in use it is likely failing; if not, the registration may be abandoned.
findings.remediation: Confirm whether the app is still in use. If it is, rotate the credential and update the consuming service. If not, remove the app registration. Either way, delete the expired credential.

findings.title: CA policy in report-only mode: Require MFA for All Users
findings.description: The Conditional Access policy 'Require MFA for All Users' is in report-only mode. It logs what it would enforce but is not blocking or requiring anything.
findings.remediation: Review the sign-in logs to assess the policy's impact. Once comfortable with the results, switch the policy state from report-only to enabled.
